How to get from
Surat Thani to Koh Phangan
intro: One of the most-asked questions for this trip: how do you actually get from Surat Thani to Koh Phangan? Here are your options compared, with the honest pick for most travelers.

blocks.html: Short answer: Surat Thani is the gateway to the Gulf islands. From the town or airport, transfer to a pier (usually Donsak), then ferry to Koh Samui in about 1.5 hours; Koh Phangan and Koh Tao continue from the same hub. Combined bus-and-ferry tickets are popular.

blocks.caption: Options compared (฿ = relative cost; check live fares to confirm)

blocks.html: The easiest option is a combined bus-and-ferry ticket bought in Surat Thani town or at the airport — a coach takes you to the pier and the ferry is included. Check the last ferry of the day if you arrive in Surat Thani in the evening.

faq.q: How do I get from Surat Thani Airport to Koh Samui?
faq.a: Buy a combined coach-and-ferry ticket at the airport; a bus takes you to Donsak pier and the ferry crosses to Samui, around 2.5–3 hours in total.

faq.q: Can I island-hop between Samui, Phangan and Tao?
faq.a: Yes — daily boats connect all three. Samui is closest, then Phangan, with Tao farthest out. Ordering the islands by distance saves time.
